project_structure: Monorepo with packages/api (FastAPI), packages/web (React), packages/db (migrations/Neo4j), packages/shared (types). API follows layered architecture: api routes -> services -> kg/graph_service -> Neo4j. Core modules: kg/ (graph_service.py with GraphService singleton), api/ (graph.py, chat.py, verification.py routes), services/ (chat_service.py), models/ (SQLAlchemy + enums). Neo4j schema defined in db/neo4j/init_cypher.cql with constraints and indexes for 9 node types (Herb, Component, Variant, Process, Trait, TimePoint, Efficacy, Flavor, Meridian) and 14 edge types.

relevant_files.rationale: Core knowledge graph service - all Neo4j operations centralized here. Singleton pattern at line 680. Provides get_herb_graph, search_nodes, verify_node, verify_relationship methods critical for TDD.
Graph API endpoints: /graph/herb/{name}, /graph/search, /graph/node/{node_id}, /graph/pending. Entry point for graph queries.
Expert review module - verification workflow. POST /verifications/ creates verification, POST /{id}/verify performs expert verification. Syncs with Neo4j at lines 142-153.
QA module - answer_question returns answer, reasoning_chain, sources, graph_data. _extract_entities, _build_reasoning_chain, _generate_answer methods.
Neo4j schema definition - constraints, indexes, node/edge type definitions. Reference for expected graph structure in tests.
Type system - NodeType, NodeStatus, EdgeType, EntityType, VerificationStatus enums. TDD assertions should reference these.
VerificationModel and VerificationEvidenceModel - database schema for review workflow.
Settings - neo4j_uri, neo4j_user, neo4j_password. Test fixtures need these for connection.

patterns: 1) GraphService singleton pattern (graph_service = GraphService() at line 680) - tests should import this instance. 2) Async/await throughout - all graph_service methods are async. 3) NodeStatus PENDING->VERIFIED/REJECTED workflow. 4) Verification links to Neo4j via verification_id stored on nodes/relationships. 5) StrEnum for type safety matching TypeScript types. 6) API returns dict responses, not Pydantic models in kg module. 7) Cypher queries use MATCH-CREATE-SET patterns.
dependencies: External: neo4j (AsyncGraphDatabase driver), postgresql+asyncpg, openai api. Internal: api routes -> services -> kg/graph_service -> Neo4j. chat_service imports graph_service. verification API imports graph_service for sync.
integration_points: 1) GraphService singleton: packages/api/app/kg/graph_service.py:680 - imported by graph.py:5, verification.py:9, chat_service.py:12. 2) /graph/* endpoints: packages/api/app/api/graph.py:7 router with prefix '/graph'. 3) /chat/question: packages/api/app/api/chat.py:12 - ChatService.answer_question. 4) /verifications/*: packages/api/app/api/verification.py:11 router prefix '/verifications'. 5) Neo4j connection: graph_service.py:30-33 driver initialization. 6) Verification sync: verification.py:144-153 graph_service.verify_node/verify_relationship calls.
constraints: 1) Neo4j relationship verification incomplete at verification.py:152 - comment indicates entity_id parsing issue for relation type. 2) All graph nodes require status, verification_id, verified_by, verified_at fields. 3) NodeStatus enum values: 'pending', 'verified', 'rejected' (lowercase). 4) GraphService methods return raw dicts, not typed models. 5) Cypher queries must handle None gracefully (see graph_service.py:86-90 get_node). 6) chat_service._extract_entities currently hardcoded herb list (line 76) - needs LLM integration for production.
